views.definition:
SELECT p.id,
    p.request_id,
    cn.customer_id,
    p.customer_number_id,
    u.full_name AS customer_name,
    u.phone AS customer_phone,
    pn.number,
    pn.provider_id,
    tp.name_ar AS provider_name,
    p.package_price_snapshot,
    p.package_duration_days_snapshot,
    p.package_currency_snapshot,
    p.starts_at,
    p.expires_at,
    p.status,
    p.created_at
   FROM ((((protections p
     JOIN customer_numbers cn ON ((cn.id = p.customer_number_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.id = cn.customer_id)))
     JOIN phone_numbers pn ON ((pn.id = cn.phone_number_id)))
     JOIN telecom_providers tp ON ((tp.id = pn.provider_id)));

WITH base AS (
         SELECT pt.id,
            pt.protection_id,
            p.customer_number_id,
            COALESCE(pt.provider_id, pn.provider_id) AS provider_id,
            u.full_name AS customer_name,
            pn.number,
            tp.name_ar AS provider_name,
            pt.task_type,
            pt.due_date AS due_at,
            COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date) AS telecom_due_at,
            pt.status,
            pt.completed_at,
            pt.completed_by,
            pt.telecom_reference,
            pt.rescheduled_reason,
            pt.scheduled_at,
            pt.created_at,
            pt.updated_at,
            pt.amount_snapshot,
            pt.amount_currency,
            pt.cycle_number,
            pt.visible_from,
            pt.planned_due_at,
            COALESCE(ts.visibility_days_before, 0) AS visibility_days_before,
            (ceil((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date) - now())) / 86400.0)))::integer AS days_remaining,
            ((COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date) < now()) AND (pt.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::task_status, 'due'::task_status]))) AS is_overdue,
            ((COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date))::date = CURRENT_DATE) AS is_due_today,
            ((pt.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::task_status, 'cancelled'::task_status])) OR (COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date) < now()) OR (pt.visible_from IS NULL) OR (pt.visible_from <= now())) AS is_visible_now,
            (pt.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::task_status, 'due'::task_status])) AS is_open,
            (pt.status = 'completed'::task_status) AS is_completed,
            (pt.status = 'cancelled'::task_status) AS is_cancelled,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((pt.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::task_status, 'due'::task_status])) AND (COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date) < now())) THEN 'overdue'::text
                    ELSE (pt.status)::text
                END AS calculated_status,
            cls.name AS classification_name,
            cls.sort_order AS classification_sort_order
           FROM (((((((payment_tasks pt
             JOIN protections p ON ((p.id = pt.protection_id)))
             JOIN customer_numbers cn ON ((cn.id = p.customer_number_id)))
             JOIN users u ON ((u.id = cn.customer_id)))
             JOIN phone_numbers pn ON ((pn.id = cn.phone_number_id)))
             JOIN telecom_providers tp ON ((tp.id = COALESCE(pt.provider_id, pn.provider_id))))
             LEFT JOIN task_settings ts ON (((ts.provider_id = COALESCE(pt.provider_id, pn.provider_id)) AND ts.is_active)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.name,
                    c.sort_order
                   FROM task_time_classifications c
                  WHERE ((c.task_settings_id = ts.id) AND c.is_active AND ((c.min_days_remaining IS NULL) OR ((ceil((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date) - now())) / 86400.0)))::integer >= c.min_days_remaining)) AND ((c.max_days_remaining IS NULL) OR ((ceil((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(pt.telecom_due_at, pt.due_date) - now())) / 86400.0)))::integer <= c.max_days_remaining)))
                  ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
                 LIMIT 1) cls ON (true))
        )
 SELECT id,
    protection_id,
    customer_number_id,
    provider_id,
    customer_name,
    number,
    provider_name,
    task_type,
    due_at,
    telecom_due_at,
    days_remaining,
    calculated_status,
    status,
    completed_at,
    completed_by,
    telecom_reference,
    rescheduled_reason,
    scheduled_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    amount_snapshot,
    amount_currency,
    cycle_number,
    visible_from,
    planned_due_at,
    visibility_days_before,
    is_overdue,
    is_due_today,
    is_visible_now,
    is_open,
    is_completed,
    is_cancelled,
    classification_name,
    classification_sort_order,
        CASE
            WHEN is_overdue THEN 0
            WHEN is_due_today THEN 1
            ELSE 2
        END AS urgency_sort
   FROM base b;

SELECT cn.id,
    cn.customer_id,
    cn.phone_number_id,
    pn.number,
    tp.id AS provider_id,
    tp.name_ar AS provider_name_ar,
    tp.name_en AS provider_name_en,
    tp.code AS provider_code,
    cn.custom_label,
    cn.is_active,
    cn.created_at,
    p.id AS active_protection_id,
    p.starts_at AS protection_starts_at,
    p.expires_at AS protection_expires_at,
    p.status AS protection_status
   FROM (((customer_numbers cn
     JOIN phone_numbers pn ON ((pn.id = cn.phone_number_id)))
     JOIN telecom_providers tp ON ((tp.id = pn.provider_id)))
     LEFT JOIN protections p ON (((p.customer_number_id = cn.id) AND (p.status = 'active'::protection_status))))
  WHERE ((cn.customer_id = auth.uid()) OR (private.current_actor_type() = 'admin'::user_type));

SELECT p.id,
    p.request_id,
    cn.customer_id,
    p.customer_number_id,
    pn.number,
    tp.name_ar AS provider_name,
    p.package_id,
    pkg.name AS package_name,
    p.package_price_snapshot,
    p.package_duration_days_snapshot,
    p.package_currency_snapshot,
    p.starts_at,
    p.expires_at,
    p.status,
    p.created_at
   FROM ((((protections p
     JOIN customer_numbers cn ON ((cn.id = p.customer_number_id)))
     JOIN phone_numbers pn ON ((pn.id = cn.phone_number_id)))
     JOIN telecom_providers tp ON ((tp.id = pn.provider_id)))
     JOIN packages pkg ON ((pkg.id = p.package_id)))
  WHERE (cn.customer_id = auth.uid());

SELECT id,
    user_type,
    full_name,
    email,
    phone,
    status,
    role_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM users
  WHERE (id = auth.uid());
